reviews.title: Great for the price. Nice features!
reviews.comment: I purchased this webcam to pair with my new 1440p monitor. I originally had the kiyo pro but opted for this low profile webcam that is more slimline and just simply looks better on my monitor. The monitor base fits perfectly with the cut line on my screen and doesn't protrude into the viewing area at all. It's almost as if they used my monitor model as the prototype....lol. the quality is decent and I especially love the privacy adjustment. Very well thought out Razer!
reviews.author: CLU55

reviews.title: Great starter
reviews.comment: Very much improved from the first version. Picture is clear and the shutter is a nice feature. For the price this is the best option for starters to mid level in my opinion.
reviews.author: Matthew M.

reviews.title: Great camera for the price
reviews.comment:
Not a bad camera for the money. Great picture. Auto focus works pretty good. I mostly use it for work, not streaming. Sits great on top of monitor without blocking any of the screen.
Make sure to actually plug it in directly. If you try to use a hub or anything like that, you will notice the performance degrade over time while it's running.
